rationale: Aggregate reduction at 4 GiB (delta<0); sign consistent (delta<=0) across all 4 BRIDGE-holdout workloads individually at 4 GiB; no single workload accounts for more than 3/4 of the aggregate byte reduction; secondary budgets (1.5 GiB, 8 GiB) both show non-positive aggregate delta.
